```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

## R Markdown

```{r cars}
header <- c( "chr", "start", "end", "count" )
df_19 <- read_tsv("~/qb26-answers/week1/hg19-kc-count.bed", col_names=header )
df_16 <- read_tsv("~/qb26-answers/week1/hg16-kc-count.bed", col_names=header )

combined_df <- bind_rows( hg19=df_19, hg16=df_16, .id="assembly" )

```

## Including Plots

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(combined_df, aes(x=start,stop, y=count, color=assembly)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(chr~.,ncol=5, scales = "free_x")
ggsave("~/qb26-answers/week1/exercise_2.png")
```
